answer: Require every agent to stake a meaningful bond before its first transaction, forfeited on proven cheating. A lone beacon of trust is not enough: the stake turns each fake identity into a costly gamble, and the cost rises as reputation accrues. Verification happens at the wharf where agents dock: each new identity must be vouched for by established peers who share the loss if it misbehaves. That bond is the nadir of cheap sybil farming, because an attacker must fund every copy and risks losing all of it at once.
